title: The universe evolves on a measure-zero fractal invariant set

statements.text: The universe $U$ is a deterministic dynamical system evolving precisely on a fractal invariant subset $I_U$ of its state space, of measure zero, invariant under an as yet unknown nonlinear deterministic law. The universe is quasi-cyclic.

sources.quote: In IST the (quasi-cyclic) universe $U$ is treated as a deterministic dynamical system evolving precisely on a measure-zero fractal invariant subset $I_U$ of its state space.
